text:
marta: Quick heads-up — spotted a dead shortlink in the runtime guide and a small curl example that returns 403 in staging. Not a showstopper but blocking the release checklist for the api-runtime work. Who can do a tiny edit and open a PR? :eyes:

sam: I can take it. Can you paste the exact file/path and the failing snippet?

marta: Path: `docs/runtime/guide.md` around the Examples section (~line 210). Broken shortlink: `/short/run-samples` -> 404. Curl sample currently:```curl -I https://internal.short/run-samples || true```which resolves to a 403 in staging. Suggest replacing the shortlink with the canonical doc path and change the curl to a `curl -sSf` check.

alex: FYI the docs link-checker also flagged this in the CI job:```[link-checker] ERROR: 1 broken link found: /short/run-samples -> 404 (docs/runtime/guide.md:213)```The preview deploy failed the healthcheck because the curl example returns 403.

jane: Short checklist: 1) replace shortlink with `/docs/runtime/guide#examples` 2) update curl to `curl -sSf https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/guide#examples` 3) add a one-liner in commit `docs: fix runtime example shortlink + curl check` 4) ping `@docs-approvers` for a quick review.

marta: Thanks — created a tiny PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12345 (PR title: "docs: fix runtime example shortlink + curl check"). Includes sed change and updated example. I triggered a preview build.

docs-bot: Preview build queued: preview.redwood.ai/pr-12345 — link-checker running.

sam: Looked at the diff, lgtm. I ran the curl locally:```curl -sSf https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/guide#examples | grep "Authorization"```returns expected snippet. Will merge once link-checker is green. :shipit:

marta: Awesome — thanks @sam. Leaving a note in the release checklist that this was a docs quickfix.

docs-bot: Link-checker passed for PR #12345 — no broken links detected. Preview deploy: https://preview.redwood.ai/pr-12345 (deployed)
